question: Related Questions Q. Assalaam alai kum, Respected Mufti Sahab, My question is that, what is the permissible method of avoiding child birth, in Islam? Can my wife use copper-T ? Please advise as soon as possible. Allah Hafiz. 3138 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 11000 Country: Canada Title: Assalamu w w w is it permissable to have IDU (copper-t)temporary birth control device-valid for 2 years gap only for a muslim women(just to upbring current child who is 8-12 months with extra care in our western country where no joint family exist)this temprary way as per some talks it is also kind of abortion due to coper-T itself built copper which melt sperm so it is a abortion ? please adivise Question: Assalamu w w w is it permissable to have IDU (copper-t)temporary birth control device-valid for 2 years gap only for a muslim women(just to upbring current child who is 8-12 months with extra care in our western country where no joint family exist)this temprary way as per some talks it is also kind of abortion due to coper-T itself built copper which melt sperm so it is a abortion ? please adivise Answer ID: 11000 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 275/199=L/1430) It is against the wish of Shariah and a cause of displeasure to adopt such method which prevents conception. Therefore, resorting to such methods is makrooh . The hadith says: تزوجوا الودود الولود Marry fertile and loving women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
